user.title: Green Hero
user.description: Choose how to connect your Green Hero account.

browser.title: Log in to Green Hero
browser.description:
**Step 1: sign in (skip if you're already logged in to Green Hero in this browser)**

[Sign in to Green Hero]({login_url}). After signing in you'll see a blank page; that's expected.

**Step 2: get the code**

Copy the whole line below, paste it into your browser's address bar and press Enter (it must start with `view-source:`; this works in Chrome, Edge and Firefox on a computer):

```
{code_url}
```

You'll see a page of code. Press **Ctrl+A** then **Ctrl+C** (Cmd on a Mac) and paste it all below. Nothing redirects, so there's no rush.

refresh_token.title: Green Hero refresh token
refresh_token.description: Paste a refresh_token from a logged-in Green Hero web session (browser console: read the `@@auth0spajs@@` localStorage entry).

error.invalid_auth: Could not log in with that code (each code works once and expires after a few minutes). Reload the `view-source:` page from step 2 to get a fresh one and paste it.
error.invalid_code: Couldn't find a code in what you pasted. Open the `view-source:` line from step 2 and paste the whole page.
error.pasted_login_link: That's a link, not the page it opens. Paste the `view-source:` line into your address bar, press Enter, then copy the whole page (Ctrl+A, Ctrl+C) and paste it here.
error.not_signed_in: Your browser isn't signed in to Green Hero yet. Do step 1 first, then step 2 again.
error.state_mismatch: That code is from a different login (an older dialog or the Green Hero app itself). Use the `view-source:` line from this dialog.
error.no_refresh_token: Login succeeded but no refresh token was returned. Try again.
